mode-a-f1.setup: F1 analyzed and exported by SAA in the same project (Mode A); non-Git working tree, no baseline confirmation, no environment.

mode-a-f1-confirmed-login-admin.setup: Mode A F1 after a baseline confirmation, scope: login and admin user list (no contradiction on their path).

mode-a-f1-checkout-changed.setup: Mode A F1 (copy) after a baseline confirmation; the local checkout changed after the analysis.

mode-a-f4-confirmed.setup: F4 analyzed and exported (Mode A) after a baseline confirmation; all flows selected.

mode-a-f4-loyalty-only.setup: Mode A F4 after a baseline confirmation, scope: the loyalty page only (its route condition is a material gap).

mode-a-f4-loyalty-override.setup: As mode-a-f4-loyalty-only, after a person marked the route-condition gap not material (audited).

mode-b.setup: The QAA runtime package (Mode B) in a project with a declared, configured but not yet validated staging environment.

mode-d.setup: The SAA contract package imported into a package-only project (Mode D); no checkout, no environment.

mode-d-stale.setup: Mode D after a newer version of the same package was imported; the older version is assessed.
